title: T02 — Create typed domain boundaries and modular architecture
description:
## Objective

Separate responsibilities and turn extension.ts into a small composition root with injectable dependencies.

## Definition of done

All checklist items are completed, relevant automated tests pass, documentation is updated where behavior changes, and no unrelated workspace changes are introduced.

> DevTracker 2.0 backlog item T02.

checklist.text: Separate tracking, domain, persistence, queries, integrations, and presentation
Define interfaces between the extension host and services
Remove mutable global state from extension.ts
Add clock, filesystem, and adapter dependency injection
Keep activate as a lightweight composition root
Document the allowed dependencies between modules
